U.note: Pre-built 32x32 scene with bevelled blocks, 9 types, undo, drag-place; dark empty sky is plain and tiny status text.

V.note: Works with a Generate button, but opens empty with flat colors and stray grid-line artifacts, little visual character.

W.note: Clean toolbar with per-block counts, but only four blocks, empty start and faint checkerboard with artifact lines.

X.note: Fill, pick and place/erase modes with 9 block types and a ground pre-filled, but plain look and grid lines bleed through blocks.

Y.note: Textured blocks, sky, clouds and a generated landscape with trees and water; polished, responsive, new-world and undo controls.

Z.note: Neat labelled toolbar with key hints and responsive wrapping, but only four blocks and an empty board with little visual interest.
